subject.title: [Feature]: Guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification (macOS parity) and classic fallback

question: Should the default interactive CLI onboarding path move from the current Crestodian conversation to a deterministic guided live-verification flow that can capture masked manual provider keys?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but changing first-run CLI UX, credential entry, and setup persistence semantics is protected by the `maintainer` label and repository setup/config compatibility policy.

options.title: Sponsor guided verification as CLI default
options.body: Build the guided CLI flow on `detectSetupInference`/`activateSetupInference`, keep `--classic` and scripted contracts unchanged, and update docs/tests for the new default.

options.title: Keep chat-first default and fix only silent persistence
options.body: Change `executeSetup` to live-test before persisting detected models, but leave manual key entry outside the onboarding TUI for now.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Leave CLI onboarding as conversational setup and document the macOS-only guided verification difference.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guided verification as CLI default
recommendation.body: Build the guided CLI flow on `detectSetupInference`/`activateSetupInference`, keep `--classic` and scripted contracts unchanged, and update docs/tests for the new default.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person authored the recent merged Crestodian onboarding implementation and this narrower follow-up request.
